questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘ACQUIRE’ is written as 'QCAUERI’, 'ADDRESS' is written as 'DDARSSE’, and ‘ABILITY’ is written as 'IBALYTI'. How will ICEBERG’ be written in that language?
questions.solution:
**Explanation:**

According to the English alphabet and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

First and third alphabets are interchanged & fifth and seventh alphabets are interchanged.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/088a01ab724f9fb2c39180f13db5c9d9a1c4b1cf893a8738fcf4527d030fcbeb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7db511ae13c512fd5ffb065795892b9f0a40b3e96445e48d7136a3e60a3eab3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/780898ae8a58c28829d01aaa5d991ea6a73881e6dfc6caf7b7d04e27dcdd2504.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e74cabeda6c440d9737fa8ce6055a95a7d5e65cfc7054d90e546b759b6c0a907.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: In a certain code language, CONVENTION is written as CNOWFOUINO. How will RESPONDENT be written in that language?
questions.solution:
Table shows the positional value of alphabets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a093b2e65f957e8b7b7b8a913dabed1c71e5c9e6ab9d4ec05824e5e09bc09c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **

**1) First three and last three letters are arranged in alphabetical order.**

**2) Middle four letters are shifted by +1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d10764b5ddf778f6458aa7176c73d2792f121121bee04e40209ab5e33ace54e.png] 

**NOTE : **__According to alphabetical order C comes first position among C, O and N.__

__According to alphabetical order I comes first position among I, N and O. __

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507804e692168cdcc5116ee4bf61ad55d3a170cc0a3996307fa025302e77f808.png] 

NOTE: __According to alphabetical order E comes first position among R, E and S. According to alphabetical order E comes first position among E, N and T. __

Hence, the correct answer is **"ERSQPOEENT".**
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'. How will 'SERGENT' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter ⇒ Shifted to the fourth position.
 
• Second letter ⇒ Shifted to the third position
 
• Third letter ⇒ Shifted to the first position 
 
• Fourth letter ⇒ Shifted to the second position
 
• Sixth and seventh letter ⇒ Interchanged their positions 
 
• Eighth letter ⇒ No change

So,

 
• 'CROWNED' is written as 'OWRCEND'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e849d011c8f2058fe9c025712ec0f5f1468d161444e9e75aa49f71ea6fe0afb.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'SERGENT' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb59983ab15bae8b1cbd68efef9123f5808201ed3aaede3f2ecd84e911342ea3.png] 

Hence, "**RGESNET**" is the correct answer.
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting

The logic followed here is that each letter is replaced by its **opposite letter in the alphabet series.**

ACDB is related to ZXWY:

**Following the same logic, IKLJ will be related to:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a2f55616df1574b4cfc0bdee6bb3d101a6200386f7412264222dbc42f4bb7f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feff0a4ee933703a7c85e33acf9accb6112b6bf9c05948f6190ba41c9c6f43e.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is __Option (4)__.**
